name: Rice Blast
symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions with grey centre on leaves; neck rot causes white panicles
favorable_conditions: Cool temperature 20-25°C; high humidity; excess N application
management_biological: Pseudomonas fluorescens 0.2% at tillering and panicle initiation
management_cultural: Avoid excess N; use resistant varieties (ADT36 resistant); drain fields

name: Rice Bacterial Blight
symptoms: Yellow to white streaks from leaf margin; kresek at seedling stage
favorable_conditions: High temperature 25-30°C; high humidity; flood conditions; wounds
management_chemical: Copper oxychloride 3 g/L; Streptocycline 0.1 g + Copper oxychloride 2 g/L
management_cultural: Use certified seed; drain excess water; reduce N at infected crop

name: Rice Sheath Blight
symptoms: Oval lesions on leaf sheath with green-grey centre and brown border
favorable_conditions: High temperature 28-32°C; high humidity; dense planting
management_cultural: Wider spacing; avoid excess N; remove infected stubble

name: Rice Brown Spot
symptoms: Circular to oval brown lesions with yellow halo on leaves
favorable_conditions: Poor soil nutrition especially K and Zn; moisture stress
management_cultural: Maintain adequate soil K and Zn; avoid drought stress

name: Rice False Smut
symptoms: Orange-yellow balls replacing grains; 1-4 grains per panicle affected
favorable_conditions: High humidity during flowering; heavy rains
management_chemical: Propiconazole 1 mL/L at boot leaf stage
management_cultural: Avoid samba/late samba susceptible varieties during wet season

name: Cotton Bollworm
symptoms: Entry holes on squares and bolls; frass visible; internal feeding
management_biological: NPV (Nuclear Polyhedrosis Virus) 1.5x10^9 POB/mL; Trichogramma egg parasitoid @ 1 lakh/acre
management_cultural: Pheromone traps (1/acre); inter-crop with maize; early planting

name: Cotton Whitefly
symptoms: Yellow mottling of leaves; honeydew secretion; sooty mold; virus vector
management_chemical: Imidacloprid 0.3 mL/L (seed treatment 5 mL/kg); Acetamiprid 0.3 g/L
management_cultural: Remove virus-infected plants; avoid overhead irrigation; reflective mulch

name: Papaya Mealybug
affected_crops: Papaya, Mulberry, Tapioca, Brinjal, Tomato, Bhendi
symptoms: White mealy coating; honeydew + sooty mold; distorted leaves
favorable_conditions: All seasons; invasive pest; rapid spread
management_cultural: Remove and destroy infested plants; field sanitation; remove weeds

name: Banana Bunchy Top Virus
symptoms: Narrow upright leaves; dark green streaks on leaf midrib; dwarfed plants
favorable_conditions: Aphid vector Pentalonia nigronervosa; infected planting material
management_chemical: No cure; remove and destroy infected plants
management_biological: Control aphid vector with Dimethoate 2 mL/L
management_cultural: Use disease-free tissue culture planting material; rogue infected plants; vector control

name: Chilli Die Back (Anthracnose)
symptoms: Dry rot of fruits; dark sunken lesions; tip die-back of shoots
management_cultural: Hot water treatment of seeds 50°C for 30 min; remove infected fruits

name: Tomato Early Blight
symptoms: Concentric ring lesions on older leaves; dark brown spots with yellow halo
favorable_conditions: Hot humid weather; overcrowded plants; poor nutrition
management_cultural: Proper spacing; remove infected leaves; balanced fertilization

name: Coconut Root Wilt
symptoms: Flaccid drooping of leaflets; yellow-orange discolouration; reduction in nuts
management_cultural: Remove infected palms; avoid wounding roots; trunk injection of antibiotics as supportive

name: Groundnut Tikka Leaf Spot
symptoms: Circular dark brown spots with yellow halo; defoliation
management_chemical: Mancozeb 2.5 g/L at 30 45 60 DAS; Carbendazim + Mancozeb combination
management_cultural: 60-day crop rotation; remove infected debris; early planting

name: Sugarcane Smut
symptoms: Black whip-like structure at top shoot replacing apical bud; chlorotic tillers
management_chemical: No effective chemical seed piece treatment; Carbendazim sett treatment 1 g/L
management_cultural: Use resistant varieties Co 86032 CO 8014; hot water treatment 52°C for 30 min

name: Rice Yellow Stem Borer
symptoms: Dead heart at vegetative stage; white ear at reproductive stage; tunneling in stem
favorable_conditions: Humid weather; transplanted crop more prone; high N
management_chemical: Cartap hydrochloride 1 kg ai/ha; Chlorantraniliprole 0.3 mL/L
management_biological: Trichogramma japonicum egg cards 40000/acre at 2-3 weeks interval
management_cultural: Uproot and destroy egg masses; clip leaf tips at transplanting; light traps

name: Powdery Mildew (Cucurbits)
symptoms: White powdery coating on upper leaf surface; yellowing; premature defoliation
favorable_conditions: Dry weather; moderate temperature 20-28°C; low humidity paradox
management_cultural: Proper spacing; avoid water stress; resistant varieties

name: Bhendi Yellow Vein Mosaic
symptoms: Bright yellow vein netting; stunted growth; small distorted fruits
favorable_conditions: Whitefly vector Bemisia tabaci; hot dry weather
management_chemical: No cure; control whitefly vector with Imidacloprid 0.3 mL/L
management_biological: Yellow sticky traps; Neem oil spray
management_cultural: Rogue infected plants early; plant barrier crops; use resistant varieties

name: Tanjore Wilt (Ganoderma Wilt)
symptoms: Yellowing; drooping of lower fronds; bracket-like fruiting bodies at base; rotting of bole
favorable_conditions: Poorly drained soils; waterlogging; injury to roots
management_chemical: No effective cure; Hexaconazole trunk injection as supportive
management_cultural: Avoid waterlogging; remove infected stumps; fumigate soil; plant on raised beds
